name: Sika Plastiment-30
paste:
SIKA® PLASTIMENT®-30: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Plastiment®-30, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sika_plastiment_-30.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Plastiment®-30 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Plastiment®-30 is a water reducing concrete admixture based on modified polycarboxylates. It improves dispersion of the cementitious materials, resulting in increased workability and/or water reduction.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Plastiment®-30 can be used to achieve increased workability without loss of strength or to increase strength without loss of workability. It can be used for most concrete applications, including pumped and structural concrete. Increasing doses of Sika® Plastiment®-30 result in longer setting time.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Plastiment®-30
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: WRRe - Water Reducer Retarder
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® Plastiment®-30 meets the requirements of AS1478.1 type WRRe
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478.1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Improved dispersion of cementitious materials.
    - Reduction in the energy required for effective mixing.
    - Higher slump can be achieved without further addition of water, or higher strength can be achieved at the same slump.
    - Fresh concrete is easier to pump, place and compact.
    - Lower water/cement ratios are possible, improving concrete strength and durability.
    - The retarding properties of Sika® Plastiment®-30 allow fresh concrete to remain workable for longer.
    - Sika® Plastiment®-30 is manufactured from selected polycarboxylates which reduce the detrimental effects caused by variations in concrete raw materials.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Aqueous solution of modified policarboxilates.
    - Appearance and colour: Brown liquid
    - Specific gravity: 1.05 g/cm³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Concrete mix design: When using Sika® Plastiment®-30, trial mixes are necessary to determine dose rates to achieve specified plastic and hardened concrete requirements.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 10 L containers
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 0°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is at least one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at 5°/35° C , protected from direct sunlight

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. Recommended dosage is 350 ml ±100 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material. This dosage can be increased to 600 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material to improve water reduction and extend setting time. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials with the particular concrete mix design and materials.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Plastiment®-30, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sika_plastiment_-30.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika Plastiment 30, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/MSDS%20Sika%20Plastiment%C2%AE%2030%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Plastiment®-30, version 10/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sds-sika-plastiment-30.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Sika® Plastiment®-30, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/epd-sika-plastiment-30.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Dispensing. Sika® Plastiment®-30 is added with the initial batching water. Never add to a dry mix.
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.6 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
